passages.note: He calls the Supreme Court's rejection of the Republican challenge to Proposition 50 a victory for the Attorney General; he says nothing about who should draw district lines or how.

rows.reasoning: The only passage on redistricting cheers a court win for Proposition 50 ("Just had another victory today") without saying who should draw the maps. It matches no rung's clauses, from "independent citizens' commissions with no elected officials involved at any level" to "the party that controls the state legislature without outside interference".
